verses.arabic: بِّسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلتِّينِ وَٱلزَّيْتُونِ
verses.translation: By the fig and the olive;
and by this city (of Makkah), a haven of peace:

verses.arabic: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ فِىٓ أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍ
verses.translation: surely We created man in the best mould;
then We reverted him to the lowest of the low,

verses.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ
verses.translation: except those who have faith and do righteous deeds. Theirs is a never ending reward.
Who, then, can give the lie to you, (O Prophet), about the Reward and the Punishment?
Is not Allah the Greatest of all sovereigns?
